title: Middle Paleolithic complex technology and a Neandertal tar-backed tool from the Dutch North Sea
lineage: The full original was inspected, but the retained cache is a source-identified researcher paraphrase. The original is a primary chemical and chronological analysis of Zandmotor and a secondary account of Campitello. Geological association, direct AMS, and the absence of a clear handle are distinguished.

passages.note: Late Pleistocene Adhesives, table 1, Zandmotor Find and Procedural Complexity and Hafting Practices.
